lessons.title: Practice ORDER BY LIMIT
lessons.description: Sort products by price descending and keep only the top 3. The test checks that the result has exactly 3 rows.
lessons.starter_code:
-- TODO: list product name and price, most expensive first, only the top 3
SELECT name, price FROM products WHERE 0;
lessons.solution_code: SELECT name, price FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 3;
